Her most famous art cycles, including The Weavers and The Peasant War, depict the effects of poverty, hunger and war on the working class. French Gates has consistently been ranked as one of the world's most powerful women by Forbes. It remains the second most-produced warplane in history, with some 34,000 built, behind the Soviet Ilyushin Il-2.
